remarks: Welcome to 5315 Zelzah Ave #16, a top-floor Encino condo with treetop views and abundant natural light. The open 1,327-square-foot floor plan includes two bedrooms and two bathrooms, with the second bedroom offering flexibility as a den or office through French doors opening to the expansive living room. Large windows bring in the surrounding greenery, while upgraded windows, recessed lighting, granite kitchen countertops, and central A/C add everyday comfort. The secured elevator building offers two side-by-side parking spaces, additional storage in front of the parking area, and access to a community pool.
